text:
maria: SynergyGrid legal requested perf numbers before final sign. Scope: chat completions (1k ctx streaming) + embeddings ingest. target p95 token-stream <= 320ms, sustained 40 qps, short 4m bursts to 200 qps. embeddings ~600 reqs/min, 512-d.
jon: high-level runbook: smoke, warmup, steady-state, burst cycles, cold-start. use their sample corpus (avg prompt ~110 tokens, gen ~210).
jon: runbook sketch:
```
phase 1: smoke 5m @ 1-2 qps (auth + payload sanity)
phase 2: warmup 20m step to 40 qps (populate KV/prefix cache)
phase 3: sustain hold 40 qps for 30m collect p50/p95/p99, token/sec, gpu util
phase 4: bursts 4x 4m @ 200 qps with 5m cool-downs
phase 5: cold-start test: restart pod & hit 10 concurrent streams
metrics: p50/p95/p99 token latency, tokens/s, gpu_mem/util, queue_depth, 5xx%
```
ana: loadgen: vegeta for HTTP + small SSE harness for streaming. example call: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream`
ana: infra sketch: sustained 40 qps -> ~2 A100-eq GPUs (commit 2). bursts to 200 qps -> +3 pre-warmed GPUs. recommend commit 2 units, burst pool 3 on-demand.
maria: rough pricing ask from procurement please (ballpark).
nana: back-of-envelope: committed ~ $42k/month for 2 units; burst burn ~ $130/hr per GPU *3 => $390/hr during spikes. refine after profiling.
kate: security checklist: customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, per-request audit logs, signed DPA. For POC we can use temporary key and capture logs. need their security contact & questionnaire.
sean (customer): will share security lead + SSO/KMS contact by EOD. please include SRE playbook with failure modes and mitigations.
jon: failure modes to list: cold-start tail spikes, cache-miss storms, network retries/fan-in. mitigations: pre-warm, prefix cache, fallback to 7B variant, rate-shaping & circuit-breaker.
infra-bot: deploy-preview: dedicated/poc-synergygrid -> provisioning started at 2024-10-14T09:05:02Z :gear:
maria: timeline: run smoke+warmup tomorrow 09:00 PT. deliver CSV + 1-paragraph exec summary within 48h. action owners: jon (loadgen + results), ana (infra & cost), kate (security checklist), sean (contacts). I'll attach the CSV to the CRM when ready. :thumbsup:
